steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Isn't it... a little... too windy here...
You wrap your coat tightly around you. The wind machine is powerful, and you have no idea how all these sand made their way here. It's as if the entire WhiteSands has been moved here.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Hey, are you okay? Don't be afraid, I'll take you to a safe place... Ah, it's you, Chief!
It's Kawa-kawa. Seeing you, his eyes widen in surprise. Suddenly, a gaudy decorative painting crashes near your feet, clearly not a product of the WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Look, it's really dangerous here, come with me quickly!

Kawa-kawa erects a small shelter with his beacons, and you both huddle inside to wait out the storm. In the meantime, he pulls out a bunch of maps, excitedly sharing with you the results of his recent expedition to the WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I am now a fully-fledged surveyor! Once I complete the mapping of the entire WhiteSands, I can open up a safe route that everyone can freely traverse!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The entire WhiteSands... that's a lot of area to cover... that's not an easy task.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: It's okay, I'm almost done! My dad brought back a lot of valuable survey data from deep within the WhiteSands, made my work so much easier!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Your dad has returned home? Please give him my regards.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: No problem! After the sandstorm ends, I'll take you home as a guest!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay, but let's do it another time. I have other things to do.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: In that case... since you still have to travel through the WhiteSands, I'll give you this, should come in handy!
He hands you something made of metal wires, which you accept solemnly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, I will make good use of it.
